scope: Spline pion DC edges loose, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/dcfid_pip/loose/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the manual baseline and opened 57 keys whose own cosine was outside the manual window or whose stored curve missed that cosine. Pass 2 put starts on 16 histograms the half-width second pass had driven off that cosine, and refit Q2-y 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 13, and 14. Unselected Q2-y bins stayed at the pass-1 result. JSON still has 452 bins. (1, 8) moved off the pinned B=-0.045 onto this histogram's cosine. The nominal B was not imposed.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Bins were not pulled toward the nominal or a neighbor. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) keeps B=-0.112987 rather than the nominal B=-0.125184 because these points support the smaller modulation. One bin, (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_5), still has a cos(2phi) error that collapses because the amplitude is consistent with zero. The free cosine does not change that shape, so the limit was not opened again. The collapsed error is a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and it is not added to the systematic budget.
unresolved: The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. The retained A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) already matches an unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_14) 6.069 (chi2 127.459, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) 6.060 (chi2 127.260, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 5.926 (chi2 124.449, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10) 5.544 (chi2 116.416, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_12) 4.910 (chi2 103.110, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) 4.833 (chi2 91.825, NDF 19); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_4) 4.629 (chi2 74.061, NDF 16); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_5) 4.622 (chi2 78.575, NDF 17); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_6) 4.593 (chi2 82.675, NDF 18); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 4.545 (chi2 54.539, NDF 12); (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_12) 4.365 (chi2 91.664, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 4.358 (chi2 65.368, NDF 15). (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is not unresolved as a guide miss: the retained curve matches the free cosine, and the remaining chi-squared is scatter inside 60-300. Isolated spikes that the cosine cannot absorb: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) pull 9.61 at 352 deg, fraction 0.74; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_12) pull 6.30 at 352 deg, fraction 0.48; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_26) pull 6.18 at 352 deg, fraction 0.48; (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_14) pull -5.74 at 112 deg, fraction 0.36. No empty histograms.
why_retained: The final pass is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, aside from a 0.0009 numerical change on (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_4), 25 are lower by more than 0.5, and the curves follow each histogram's own cosine. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. The overlay in overlays/loose_final.png shows the retained curve on the points and the stored curve. Fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty. Histogram bin contents match the source file.
